response.query: What trauma-informed protocols, mandatory reporting rules, interviewer training modules, and local referral pathways will protect participants when discussing sensitive archival materials?
response.answer: Trauma-informed protocols, mandatory reporting rules, interviewer training, and local referral pathways ensure participant safety. Training should include recognizing trauma signs and responding appropriately. Local referrals provide support for those affected.
